$comment: Seed data for product-service (product_db). GENERATED by infra/scripts/generate-seed-products.py — edit the script, not this file. One product = one object with nested variants[] and images[]; brand/category are referenced by name so the seed runner can look up/create the parent rows. frame_shape is the FRAME shape (enum: ROUND|SQUARE|OVAL|CAT_EYE|AVIATOR|RECTANGLE|WAYFARER|RIMLESS); face_shapes lists the FACE shapes the product suits. material_type is one of ACETATE|METAL|TITANIUM|TR90|PLASTIC|MIXED (material stays the free-text Vietnamese label); lens/bridge/temple/frame width are integers in mm. Image kind is GALLERY or TRY_ON (exactly one product-level TRY_ON transparent PNG per product). base_price/extra_price are in VND (no decimals in practice, stored as numeric(10,2)). Products after the first 10 are illustrative data for the thesis.
